brief.headline: Push for longer payment terms (45–60 days) — they already take 105 days to pay their own suppliers, so asking for more time is only fair.

priceAsk.summary: Go to the maker's price — they are 100% trader, so their price includes a reseller margin that we should not pay.
priceAsk.target: Benchmark to Manjushree Technopack or another direct manufacturer; typical market ask for a 28 mm PP cap is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume.
priceAsk.basis: They make nothing — 100.0% of their sales are traded goods. Their price carries a reseller margin. Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, B health score) is India's largest rigid-plastic converter and a direct maker; get their price and use it to strip out the middleman cost.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Ask for 45–60 days to pay instead of 30 days.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Moving to 45 days frees up ₹2.68 L of our cash; going to 60 days frees up ₹5.36 L.

brief.financialLeverage: They keep only 2.8% of every ₹100 they sell as profit (peer firms keep 3.1%), so there's almost no room for a big price cut without hurting them. But they already take 105 days to pay their own suppliers — way longer than similar firms (57 days) — so asking them to give us 45–60 days is fair and won't stress them. We're 1.19% of their total ₹54.69 Cr in sales — that's real leverage. Their money-health score is weak (2/10) and they're in the grey distress zone (Altman Z 1.58), so don't squeeze too hard — line up a second source instead and use that to hold the line on terms and maker pricing.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, B health 65/100) — makes pharma bottles, caps and preforms in-house; no middleman margin.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong and profitable, a robust second source for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Pan-India resin manufacturer found in public web research — verify capability and price before issuing RFQ.

risks: Their money-health score is very weak (2/10) and they sit in the grey distress zone (Altman Z 1.58) — don't pile on volume without a qualified backup ready to step in.
They have pending legal case(s) flagged — ask Legal to review before locking in a long-term contract or exclusivity.
They are a pure reseller (0.0% manufactured) — if their upstream maker raises prices or cuts them off, we have no direct relationship to fall back on.
Their profit is only 2.8% of sales — a hard price squeeze could tip them into loss and threaten supply continuity; fight the battle on payment terms and dual-sourcing instead.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move to 45–60 day payment terms — you already take 105 days with your own suppliers, so it's only fair we get similar breathing room.
